name: pane-body-composer-gap-phone
description: On a phone the breakpoint's own .body rule declares a different bottom inset; a pane that docks a footer must still close its scrolling body on the footer's top hairline, while a footer-less pane keeps the phone's inset.

mutation.declaration: panescaffold.module.css: remove the rule that zeroes the bottom padding of a body whose pane docks a footer
mutation.note: Measured 2026-11-11: without the rule this case fails at 390px with a 16.0px empty band above the docked footer (body padding-bottom 16px), the phone breakpoint's own inset. The footer-less control still read 16px in both runs.
